trend: University of Copenhagen: frequent coffee drinkers had more gut microbial diversity and lower small-intestine pH (US News, 13 Nov)
why: Coffee plus gut is exactly the Mornings pairing. States that the study does not show cause, then names the doses.
text:
A Copenhagen study: regular coffee drinkers had a more diverse gut microbiome and lower pH in the small intestine.

It doesn't show cause yet. We already pair the two in SILT Mornings: 80 mg caffeine with 5 g PHGG fibre and 6 billion probiotics.

Does coffee agree with your gut?
